product_metadata.title: Trudeau 11-Inch Silicone Splatter Screen, Red
features: 11-inch splatter screen to protect stovetop and clothing from grease
Fashioned from durable silicone for versatile use and easy cleanup
Also functions as a pot-strainer and an attractive trivet
Eared handles are easy to use and simplify both storage and dishwashing
Heat-resistant to 500 degrees F; safe in the dishwasher
description: Trudeau’s innovative multi-purpose 11” silicone splatter screen features an easy to clean surface. Side handles make for super easy storage (no long handle to contend with) and fits easily in the dishwasher. Also, side handles use less room on the stove top when cooking with multiple pans. Spatter screen is heat resistant up to 500 degrees F. Cleverly designed to be used as a trivet, pot strainer or splatter screen.

Trudeau delivers a smart, versatile kitchen tool with this splatter screen that also acts as a trivet and pot-strainer. Crafted from durable, heat-resistant silicone, the screen protects clothing and cooking surfaces from splattering grease. In contrast to old-style metal screens, it has eared handles that make it easier to store and clean, and it pops right into the dishwasher, so grease does not accumulate over time. Its space-efficient design is also nice on the table when it is acting as a trivet. Heat-resistant to 500 degrees F, the piece measures 11 inches in diameter and comes in a fun shade of red. Trudeau includes a five-year warranty.
